nature_of_change: OBSERVABILITY_AND_FAILURE_PATH — this stage modifies exception handling, failure classification and optional diagnostics wiring. It is NOT a byte-identical runtime change claim.
explicit_non_claim: The post-RCA-1 runtime is NOT the frozen RuntimeBaselineV3 byte-identity and MUST NOT be treated as the runtime that produced the B2 24-run series or the Gen-4 acceptance series. Any future model qualification re-runs on a fresh measurement root under §14 regardless.

changed.behavior_delta: pre-RCA-1: an INTEGRATE-stage model/provider exception propagated out of run_loop into the benchmark runner and collapsed into failure_layer=RUNTIME + str(exc)[:500] with NO trajectory event. post-RCA-1: it is contained as a first-class cycle outcome (integration_status='failed'), persists a supervisor_integration_failed trajectory event with the type-derived cause, fails the AgentRun (internal_failure), and stops the loop. Fail-closed: no decision is committed, nothing re-executes.
changed.visibility: failure path only; zero effect on any success path

changed.behavior_delta: map_provider_exception now recognizes openai transport errors BY TYPE (APITimeoutError -> agent_timeout retryable; APIConnectionError -> agent_provider_unavailable). BenchmarkRunner failure records gain optional type-derived fields (failure_class/failure_classified/exception_class/exception_module/cause_chain/http_status) beside the legacy flat record. Legacy artifacts remain parseable.
changed.visibility: failure paths only; delegation failure codes for already-correct classes unchanged

changed.behavior_delta: when LLM_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTICS is unset/false (default) the sink resolves to None and every emission site is a no-op — byte-identical behaviour. When explicitly enabled, sanitized JSONL failure entries are appended.

RCA-1.5 corrected decision tree (exhaustiveness, REVIEW_REQUIRED, class-specific blockers, explicit accounting block, per-class attribution text, axis-split ceiling names). Benchmark-side script, not production runtime.
